summary: Los Angeles, California, programmer, Biola University graduate, Torrey Honors Institute, strong interest in philosophy, particularly Plato and Aristotle, advocates for classical education, supports microfinancing initiatives, critical of Western approaches to aid, views on consciousness and AI, strong Christian beliefs, autodidact, enjoys classical music and silence, homeschooled for part of life, interested in integrating technology and education, engages in discussions about social issues and ethics, values deep understanding over superficial knowledge, critical of materialism and relativism, emphasizes the importance of trust in social networks.
